item.title: Trump administration asks Washington to set aside ballots from 400 voters it says may be noncitizens

item.title: US told Venezuelan authorities that opposition leader Machado should be allowed to return
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio says the Trump administration told Venezuela’s interim authorities “weeks and weeks ago” that opposition leader María Corina Machado should be allowed to return.

item.title: United flight turned around after report of passenger making a terroristic threat
item.description: Police say a United Airlines flight heading to Newark, New Jersey, returned to Las Vegas shortly after takeoff due to a report that a passenger had made a terroristic threat.

item.title: Man serving a life sentence for murder slips through a fence and escapes a Tennessee prison
item.description: Authorities say a man serving a life sentence for murder has escaped from a prison in northwest Tennessee.
